messages:
nina: Heads-up: found a customer using delegated tokens where the console shows the SA owner project for quota/billing instead of the originating project. They flagged wrong-team alerts.
charlie: Can you paste a minimal repro (headers + token type)?
nina: repro: ```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer exch-TOKEN-9
X-Delegated-Project: proj-storefront
X-Trace: t-4321
```
charlie: Router currently treats all SA-derived tokens as billing-bound to the token principal. That avoided trusting headers historically. Exchange tokens now include a signed `orig_project` claim from the exchange service.
devon: We should update the attribution resolver to prefer verified exchange claims, then validated origin headers, then token owner fallback. But keep it behind a feature flag and org opt-in.
joyce: UX: we need the console to surface both values so users see what's being billed vs who owns the SA. Suggested columns: "Requested project" and "Resolved billing project" with a help tooltip.
product-bot: Note: enterprise contracts may assume owner-project billing. If default flips, we need legal/sales review. Start opt-in only.
charlie: Telemetry first: emit `auth.attribution.mismatch` (bool), `auth.attribution.source` (exchange|header|token), and `auth.exchange.token_seen` (count). Tag by org, route, and token_type.
devon: Also add audit log entry (structured) behind FF: `resolved_attribution=proj-storefront,source=exchange,proof_verified=true`. Keep payload size small and retention 30d.
joyce: I'll prototype the quota table mockup showing both columns and a per-org toggle labeled "Attribution mode: token-owner|delegated-first". Include microcopy: "We resolve billing project using verified exchange tokens when enabled."
charlie: Rollout plan: (1) enable telemetry and logs FF for 14 days, (2) onboard 3 pilot orgs (opt-in), (3) 1% traffic canary for opt-ins, (4) increase to 10% and monitor for 30 days, (5) consider default change only after cross-org approvals.
nina: Dev tasks: router change behind FF, telemetry + audit logs, console columns + org toggle. QA: tests for tampered exchange claims should ensure we only trust `orig_project` when `proof_verified=true`.
devon: I'll split into PRs: A) metrics + audit log, B) router resolution behind FF with unit tests, C) console API + feature flag.
charlie: Billing downstream: add an optional ingestion field `resolved_attribution` so ETL can choose to use it. Please add sample event format in migration doc.
ops-bot: Created INFRA-3333: delegated attribution resolver + telemetry + org toggle.
product-bot: I'll collect impacted contracts and loop in legal/sales for default-change implications.
joyce: I'll add the mockups and copy to the UX ticket and link back here.
charlie: Good. Keep it opt-in until we have 30 days of clean telemetry.
nina: Thanks 0. Ping me when dashboards are up and I'll run a sample sweep of tenants that saw mismatches.
ops-bot: Reminder: enable 30d retention for FF audit logs and schedule a review after pilot phase.
